all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Abbreviation of EEA Member or Collaborating Country.
Unique international identifier of the spatial unit for which the data is being reported.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: http://dd.eionet.europa.eu/vocabulary/wise/SpatialUnit/

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Specification of whether the spatial unit is a country ('countryCode'), a Water Framework Directive river basin district ('euRBDCode') or a Water Framework Directive sub-unit ('euSubUnitCode'). For data providers that do not report under the WFD, spatial units equivalent to river basin districts ('eionetRBDCode') or sub-units ('eionetSubUnitCode') should be used.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: http://dd.eionet.europa.eu/vocabulary/wise/IdentifierScheme/

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Name of the determinand.
See the code list values for a definition of each category.

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Information if the Emission value is aggregated from E-PRTR Facilities or from non-E-PRTR Facilities or from both together. See codelist for details.
Annual emission of nutrients (tonne/year), organic matter (tonne/year) or hazardous substances (kg/year) from a specific source of emissions, aggregated by spatial unit.
Unit of measure for the reported emission value.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: http://dd.eionet.europa.eu/vocabulary/aq/UomEmissions/

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Method used in the quantification of the emissions value.

Remarks, comments or explanatory notes.
Unique metadata identifier of version of the feature or record. Url that points either to the source of the reported data or to a page providing information on the data origin.
Timestamp when the feature or record was created. In case of reported data it's the release date and time of the respective CDR envelope.
Status of the feature or record regarding its registration.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions:
valid: accepted and valid reported feature or record;
experimental: derived feature or record, e.g. legacy record converted to the new structure by EEA or records with updated spatial identifiers

all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is a monitoring site.

euMonitoringSiteCode: WFD identifier

Unique international identifier of the water body being monitored.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is a water body.

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Specification of whether the water body is a WFD water body ('euGroundwaterBodyCode' or 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode') or not ('eionetGroundwaterBodyCode' or 'eionetSurfaceWaterBodyCode').
Name of the water body
Additional classification value which further specialises the type of management, regulation or restriction zone, represented by this spatial object.
Specification of whether a water body is identified as natural, artificial (AWB) or heavily modified (HMWB).
For heavily modified river or lake water bodies, the value indicates whether the water body is a reservoir that has been created by damming a river or an existing lake.
Member State code for the characterisation type of the surface water body under the WFD.
Unique international identifier of the river basin district sub-unit.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is an RBD sub-unit.

Name of the river basin district sub-unit.
Unique international identifier of the river basin district.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is an RBD.

all_field_definition_source_records.Element definition: Identifier defining the scheme assigned to the spatial object identifier.
Name of the river basin district.
Information about the sensitivity and confidentiality status of the monitoring site location.
all_field_definition_source_records.Value definitions:
F: Free for publication;
N: Not for publication
